titleEn: eSIM for Peru – Connected from Lima to the Andes and the Amazon
contentEn:
Travel Peru Without Roaming Worries

Lima's world-class gastronomy scene, the Incan citadel of Cusco, and the breathtaking ruins of Machu Picchu – Peru packs extraordinary experiences into every day. Sim2Me's eSIM for Peru keeps you connected for navigation, translation apps, and sharing from the Andes.

Why Choose Sim2Me?

  • Coverage on Claro Peru and Entel Peru.
  • 4G LTE in Lima and Cusco – instant activation before departure.
  • Works at altitude (note: signal is limited at the Machu Picchu ruins themselves, as is natural).
  • Simple setup, no Spanish required.

Network Performance in Peru

4G LTE in Lima, Cusco, Arequipa, and Trujillo. 3G on the main Andean highways and in Puno near Lake Titicaca. Amazon basin towns like Iquitos have 3G/4G on main streets.

Quick Installation Guide

  • QR code by email.
  • Add plan in device settings.
  • ¡Bienvenidos al Perú!
